feeds.title: Dawn Coppock Blog
feeds.description: News, Updates, and Resources for Legal Professionals and those who follow adoption law. Dawn Coppock is Tennessee's leading adoption attorney. She represents foster parents, adoptive parents, birth parents, and relatives in legal adoption cases.

feeds.title: Gulf Coast Adoptions Blog
feeds.description: Gulf Coast Adoption's blog page is dedicated to spreading awareness and informing visitors about all things adoption-related so you can more easily navigate this process. It is a family-run law firm representing adoptive parents in all aspects of private adoptions, including newborn, step-parent, relative, second parent, and adult.

feeds.title: Adoption & Surrogacy Blog
feeds.description: Resource for adoption and surrogacy news, updates, stories, and community-building. Hausmann & Hickman provides information and support to those thinking about and/or involved in adoption or surrogacy. Michelle Hausmann and Amy Hickman are Florida Bar Board Certified Adoption Lawyers who specialize in adoption and reproductive law.

feeds.title: Lifetime Adoption, Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on topics such as adoption, adoption journey, adoption process, adoption preparation, domestic adoption, open adoption, parenting, infertility and much more. The founder and CEO, Mardie Caldwell, C.O.A.P., is a certified open adoption practitioner and is bonded and fully insured as an adoption facilitator in the state of California under the provisions of the Registry of California Adoption Facilitators. The mission is to help adoptive families and birth parents come together.

feeds.title: Tate Healey Webster Blog
feeds.description: Firm Announcements and Adoption Law Updates. Jeanne's goal is to create a law firm dedicated solely to the practice of adoption law.

feeds.title: Law Office of Cofsky & Zeidman, LLC Blog
feeds.description: Covers Adoption Myths, Process, Domestic and International Adoption, Post-adoption service, Step-parent adoption, Single parent adoption, Second parent adoption, and more.

feeds.title: Florida Adoption Council Blog
feeds.description: Florida Adoption Council's mission is to equip those working in the field of adoption to provide quality services to birth parents and prospective adoptive parents within a framework of adoption laws.

feeds.title: Bruce & Bruce Blog
feeds.description: The blog focuses on Adoption and Family Law. Steven and Rebecca Bruce founded Bruce & Bruce that provides personal service to individuals and families in the Muncie area for criminal defense, family law, and adoptions.

feeds.title: South Carolina Adoption Law Blog
feeds.description: This law blog provides news & commentary on legal developments regarding adoption within the state of South Carolina. Topics include interstate adoption, family law, and termination of parent's rights.

feeds.title: Florida Adoptions Blog
feeds.description: They have specialization in all areas of adoption law including private placement adoption with infants and children, step-parent adoption, relative adoption, foster care adoption, and adult adoption. Florida Adoption aims to assist potential families and birth mothers through the adoption process.

feeds.title: Lehnhardt Price Family Law Blog » Adoption
feeds.description: Lehnhardt Price Family Law is a full-service family law office that offers experienced representation for the most important legal matters of your life. Covers articles on Adoption law.

feeds.title: The Adoption Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: Helping families experience the miracle of adoption! The Adoption Law Firm is specifically focused on domestic and international adoptions. Whether you are an expectant parent or an adoptive parent, The Adoption Law Firm can help you navigate the complex and emotional landscape of adoption.

feeds.title: Adoption Law Group Blog
feeds.description: Adoption Law Group is a law firm in Southern California dedicated exclusively to adoption. We assist clients with stepparent adoption, adult adoption, international readoption, fost-adopt finalizations, and guardianship.
